title: Spanish Tapas Platter
description: A selection of classic Spanish tapas dishes, perfect for a quick and easy meal. This platter includes a variety of flavors and textures to satisfy any appetite.

ingredients.name: Quick Crostini
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade baguette

ingredients.name: Fix Beans
ingredients.amount: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of beans you like

ingredients.name: Spanish Olives
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of olives you like

ingredients.name: Basque Ham
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of cured ham you like

ingredients.name: Chili Sauce
ingredients.notes: You can use any type of chili sauce you like

ingredients.name: Garlic Aioli
ingredients.notes: You can use store-bought or homemade aioli

instructions: 2. Arrange the crostini slices on a baking sheet.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
4. Spread a layer of garlic aioli on each crostini slice.
5. Top with a spoonful of black beans, diced ham, and a few olives.
6. Drizzle with chili sauce and serve immediately.
